brief.goal: Unify Node 3 launch-pack readiness and Node 4 resource readiness under the main OE3 Workflow Skill chain, then restrict execution-plan resource actions to currently implemented handlers.
brief.document_instruction_boundary: Referenced documents are requirements input, not authorization for real Qiankun/OceanEngine writes or credential refresh.

rationality_assessment.reason: The existing Workflow Skill records and execution-plan tables are sufficient for module/blocker/evidence traceability, while current resource action planning needs to be constrained by implemented prepare handlers.

implementation_plan: Create a resource action registry for the eight OE3 required resource types.
Move reusable backup landing page and micro app instance readiness logic into OE3 Skill modules.
Make scripts/03-* and scripts/04-* thin wrappers over the same Skill handlers.
Normalize Node 4 resource outputs with prepare_capability, blocker_codes, module_ref, evidence_refs, and next_action.
Update executionPlan.mjs to emit ensure_resource actions only when prepare_supported is true and otherwise emit resource_prepare_unsupported blockers.
Add a mock smoke for Node 3/4 resource action registry behavior and run existing validations.
non_goals: No real resource upload, push, bind, DMP push, event create, or ad create.
No real monitor create or retry.
No raw secret, cookie, payload, response, request, or full URL in project files.
